decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY expanding clear-on-activation to Vejledning and Bestyrelsesseminar; no additional candidate-state change is required.
The date-selector scope change is independently stated by the date-function clauses and is already represented by a same-message MODIFY; the visual-cue scope change adds nothing further.
Expanding visible fillable-field cues does not change the checklist control type or its scope.
The source scope change concerns visible input cues, not preservation of title-field formatting.
The source does not modify help-label text, placement, hover behavior, or scope, and the candidate already applies to all control fields.
Extending visible field cues does not necessarily change the underlying robust placeholder mechanism, which already applies to interactive fields generally.
The source decision does not change the dropdown control type, document, or scope.
Multiline entry beneath Item and Title is an independent requirement already introduced by another clause in the same message.
Continuous-text line spacing is independently established by the line-break clauses and is not changed by expansion of visible field cues.
The visual-cue scope expansion does not alter automatic bullet continuation when Enter is pressed.
Fixed margins in Vejledning are an independent layout requirement already introduced by a separate clause in the same message.
The Master-template bullet review is independent of visible fillable-field cues and does not change the candidate's required bullet formatting state.
